pages.title: Cosmic Ray Shard
pages.text: Crystal scarred by the tracks of cosmic rays - nuclei flung across the Galaxy by supernova shocks at nearly the speed of light.

Made in $(item)Interstellar Scoop$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Cosmic Ray Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Pulsar Wisp.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Pulsar Beacon chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Interstellar Medium.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Burst Afterglow Crystal, Magnetic Monopole, Magnetite, Scintillator Panel.
